RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Giving a numerical probability would imply knowledge we don’t have.

Your PhD and eight years’ management experience are substantial, but don’t automatically outweigh another candidate’s leadership experience or performance against the selection criteria.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and the reasons for selecting the successful candidate.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-related comments, inconsistent criteria, or preferential treatment linked to sex—not merely the panel’s composition. Check local complaint deadlines while awaiting the explanation; jurisdiction and whether the hospital is public may affect your rights.
